text:
Tim Stützle is getting MVP talk in Ottawa (the Ottawa Citizen's phrase was an "MVP-calibre start"), and TSN's Mike Johnson has been talking about his 200-foot game. Twenty-three points in 19 games, nearly 22 minutes a night, and since William Eklund went down he has moved onto the line with Dylan Cozens and Fabian Zetterlund.

Some cooling is likely. He's shooting 21% against 18% last season, and his points per 60 sit near the top of our range. But Ottawa takes 57% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, and his last ten games came in right at his expected points, so the play underneath is sound.

He carries the puck in on 62% of his entries and sits in the 95th percentile for primary shot assists in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. Evolving-Hockey had him 29th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement. Our range: 80 to 107 points.
